issues.description: FR3 and FR4 are not directly exercised by the mutation set (no mutant specifically breaks status-always-zero absent SR1 trigger, and no mutant breaks the exact function signature), though both are still checked by evaluate.py and would be caught by other failure modes.

recommendations: Consider adding a mutant that flips the function signature or return type to strengthen FR4 coverage evidence, and a mutant that violates FR3 independent of SR1 (e.g., status depends on plaintext instead of key) to close the untested_requirements gap.
